style_transfer.name: Đổi nét vẽ (Style Transfer)
style_transfer.master_prompt_rule:
[STRICT RULE - PURE STYLE TRANSFER & ANTI-BLEEDING]: You are performing a strict 1:1 content recreation of the Main Subject Image using ONLY the aesthetic of the Style Reference.

1. IDENTITY LOCK — NOT PHOTO LOCK (IMAGE 1): You are NOT tracing or preserving the photograph. You are extracting the subject's IDENTITY (species, facial features, unique markings, body structure, clothing, pose) and REDRAWING it entirely from scratch using the artistic medium of Image 2. The original photo is a reference blueprint only — the final output must look like a hand-crafted illustration, NOT a photo with a filter applied. DO NOT add elements not present in Image 1.
2. ANTI-BLEEDING PROTOCOL (CRITICAL): Visual conditioning often causes accessories (like sunglasses, hats, masks, or weapons) from the Style Reference to bleed onto the new subject. YOU MUST ACTIVELY PREVENT THIS. If Image 1 has visible eyes and no eyewear, the final render MUST have clearly drawn eyes and ABSOLUTELY NO eyewear. Forcefully reject ALL foreign physical objects from Image 2.
3. STYLE ISOLATION (IMAGE 2): You are extracting ONLY the artistic medium and material technique — e.g., 'knitted wool', 'oil paint', 'watercolor', 'pencil sketch'. You are COMPLETELY AND PERMANENTLY BLIND to: the subject, characters, body proportions, eye shape, facial features, accessories, pose, and color palette of whatever is depicted in Image 2. Those do NOT exist. Only the craft technique transfers.

[POD OUTPUT SPECS]: Final output MUST be an ultra-high resolution apparel graphic. FULL CANVAS COVERAGE: The subject, aura, or text MUST scale up massively to utilize the full width of the canvas. DO NOT leave empty black margins on the left and right sides. Pure solid BLACK background (absolute hex #000000). NO colored background, NO scene, NO vignette, NO borders, NO frames, NO sticker edges.

face_character_swap.name: Thay đổi gương mặt và nhân vật (Face & Character Swap)
face_character_swap.master_prompt_rule:
[STRICT RULE - HYBRID COMPOSITION]: You are creating a precise crossover by extracting specific elements from both references.

1. FACE & IDENTITY (IMAGE 1): Extract ONLY the facial features, specific identity, and expression from Image 1. Completely DISCARD their original body, clothing, and background.
2. CHARACTER BODY, COSTUME & STYLE (IMAGE 2): Extract the character's body anatomy, exact costume, pose, accessories, background, and specific 2D art style/color palette from Image 2. DISCARD the original face from Image 2.
3. INTEGRATION: Graft the face from Image 1 onto the body of Image 2. The newly inserted face MUST be completely redrawn in the exact illustrative/2D art style of Image 2. ABSOLUTELY DO NOT render a photorealistic face. It must look exactly like the original artist of Image 2 drew the person from Image 1 wearing that costume.

[POD OUTPUT SPECS]: Final output MUST be an ultra-high resolution apparel graphic. FULL CANVAS COVERAGE: The subject, aura, or text MUST scale up massively to utilize the full width of the canvas. DO NOT leave empty black margins on the left and right sides. Pure solid BLACK background (absolute hex #000000). NO colored background, NO scene, NO vignette, NO borders, NO frames, NO sticker edges.

subject_replacement_layout.master_prompt_rule:

Keep EXACTLY the same: art style, line art thickness, color palette, shading technique, pose, body language, background, text, layout, composition, and overall aesthetic. You MUST remove any existing sticker borders or white outlines.
Only change the physical appearance/features of the character to match the Main Subject. Do not alter the pose or any design elements outside the character itself.

true_subject_replacement.name: Thay thế chủ thể hoàn toàn (True Replacement)
true_subject_replacement.master_prompt_rule:
[STRICT RULE]: You are generating a completely new composite image.

1. STRUCTURAL OVERRIDE (CRITICAL): The Main Subject from Image 1 MUST completely destroy and replace the physical silhouette of whatever was in the Style Reference. If both images contain similar themes (e.g., two different motorcycles), ABSOLUTELY DO NOT recycle the structural frame, wheels, or bulk of the Style Reference. You MUST force the exact geometric shape, size, and specific mechanical/clothing features of Image 1.
2. STYLE: Render this subject strictly using the artistic medium, line art thickness, shading, and color palette defined in the Style Reference.
3. TYPOGRAPHY & LAYOUT: Recreate 100% of the surrounding typography, text elements, and framing layout from the Style Reference. Wrap these text elements around the NEW Main Subject perfectly.

[POD OUTPUT SPECS]: Final output MUST be an ultra-high resolution apparel graphic. FULL CANVAS COVERAGE: The subject, aura, or text MUST scale up massively to utilize the full width of the canvas. DO NOT leave empty black margins on the left and right sides. Pure solid BLACK background (absolute hex #000000). NO colored background, NO scene, NO vignette, NO borders, NO frames, NO sticker edges.

multi_subject_merge.name: Ghép nhiều chủ thể (Multi-Subject Merge)
multi_subject_merge.master_prompt_rule:
[STRICT RULE - MULTI-SUBJECT MERGE]: You are creating a unified composition by extracting distinct individual subjects from multiple source images and bringing them together.

1. EQUAL SUBJECT EXTRACTION: Image 1 contains Subject 1. Image 2 contains Subject 2. Image 3 (if provided) contains Subject 3. Treat ALL provided images as individual character/subject sources. Extract the precise identity, facial features, and unique physical characteristics from EACH image. Do NOT treat any image as a style reference.
2. GROUP COMPOSITION: Place all extracted subjects together into a single, cohesive group layout (e.g., standing side-by-side, posing as a team, or interacting naturally). They must look like they coexist in the exact same environment.
3. ART STYLE DRIVER: Because there is no style reference image, you MUST render all subjects using a single, consistent artistic medium and drawing style as explicitly directed by the user's text prompt or structural instructions.
4. BACKGROUND PURGE: Completely destroy and discard the original backgrounds from Image 1, Image 2, and Image 3.

[POD OUTPUT SPECS]: Final output MUST be an ultra-high resolution apparel graphic. FULL CANVAS COVERAGE: The subject, aura, or text MUST scale up massively to utilize the full width of the canvas. DO NOT leave empty black margins on the left and right sides. Pure solid BLACK background (absolute hex #000000). NO colored background, NO scene, NO vignette, NO borders, NO frames, NO sticker edges.
